continuity_review.reason: At normal pet size the loop advances up, right, down, left, and back to up without a rear view, wrong quadrant, or visible reversal. Metric outliers occur where the flat head changes between profile and frontal pitch but do not create a conspicuous visual snap.

leg_grounding_review.reason: Every standing cell uses simple gray rounded legs planted on the baseline. No standing foot exposes a forward-facing sole, pink pad, or toe bean; profile cells use a compact side-view leg silhouette.

style_review.reason: All cells use a simplified 2D silhouette, thick rounded black line work, gray-and-black graphic regions, and no plush, fabric, fur, photographic, or 3D material treatment.
